rationale: The candidate reads as one dominant prismatic mass across all four views, so it has basic gesture clarity and a defendable hierarchy. However, the form is still very tower-like and only lightly articulated by a small cut/notch; the planned courtyard/terrace idea is not legible as a public void, and the ground edge appears largely sealed rather than actively responding to the verified road frontage. In top/oblique views the parcel is roughly occupied coherently, but the visible section logic is too generic for neighborhood living: there is no convincing inhabited ground threshold, no clear public court, and the roof/upper transitions feel like a clipped object rather than a capacity-aware living section. This makes the mass only weakly program-appropriate despite decent overall coherence.
